_note: Boot-gate commands: wait_for_db polls the DB connection; wait_for_migrations polls the migration plan. Sources: db/management/commands/wait_for_db.py:1-24, wait_for_migrations.py:1-26.
bugs: BUGS: wait_for_db's retry branch is dead in practice — connections['default'] only builds the connection wrapper and never raises OperationalError (only a real query does), so the loop always exits after one pass and 'Database available!' prints even when the DB is down. PORT (translate the one-shot check, keep the typo'd line for the unreachable branch).
BUGS: 'waititng' typo in wait_for_db.py:21 — PORT verbatim.

exit_codes.0: handle returns (always; the only exception path is an unexpected raise, which Django turns into traceback + exit 1)

stdout_sequence: Database unavailable, waititng 1 second... (:21, unstyled, per retry — unreachable in practice, see BUGS) + time.sleep(1) (:22)

wait_for_migrations.handle_loop: while _pending_migrations(): write 'Waiting for database migrations to complete...' (:17, unstyled) then time.sleep(10) (:18); on exit write style.SUCCESS('No migrations Pending. Starting processes ...') (:20 — note capital P in 'Pending' and space before '...')
wait_for_migrations.help: Wait for database migrations to complete before starting Celery worker/beat (:13)

pending_check.returns: bool(executor.migration_plan(targets)) — True while any migration is unapplied
